integrity: All reported flip counts, isomorphism witnesses and automorphism orbit counts have a standalone exhaustive checker and embedded certificate. The 2019 one-flip example and the 2026 classification are treated as prior facts.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two eleven-vertex flag RP2 types, and flag-preserving 2-2 flips only; no claim for larger flag manifolds, arbitrary bistellar moves, or non-flag triangulations. Computational proof is exhaustive for the two given graph6 encodings and relies on the published independent census for global completeness. The 2026 full PDF was inaccessible; author-maintained source data were inspected. Independent validation not performed.
title: Complete flag-preserving diagonal flips between minimal eleven-vertex projective-plane triangulations
